{{Top|leg}}
The '''Training Cavern''' was part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Oracle Base]] on [[Tel III]] in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]]. The Training Cavern was the domain of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Gar Berra|Gar "Crazy Man" Berra]], who oversaw the training of new recruits and seasoned soldiers alike.
